topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines its focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen and damage recognition via pattern recognition receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular mechanisms and receptor families through which the innate immune system detects microbial infection and cellular damage.

topics.label: Acute inflammatory cascades and leukocyte trafficking
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the cellular processes mobilized during acute inflammation, from sentinel cell activation and leukocyte extravasation to systemic inflammatory effects.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the mechanisms that shut down inflammation, rebuild damaged tissue, and manage persistent infection through chronic inflammation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of the next topic
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing for the lecture and indicates the topic of the next session.
